text.en: SUNSET, CLOUDTOP WATCH. Year 401: 19:42 at midsummer. Year 405: 19:31. Year 409: 19:12 — I have checked the glass twice. Year 411: the reports go down the mountain and nothing comes back. Last page: Found a small light asleep in the snow by the cairn, warm as a coal. It woke and asked me how old it was. I did not know what to tell it.
text.zh: 云顶观日哨·日落记录。第401年：仲夏19:42。第405年：19:31。第409年：19:12——我把沙漏查了两遍。第411年：报告送下山，再没有回音。最后一页：在石堆旁的雪里发现一点睡着的光，暖得像炭火。它醒了，问我它多大了。我不知道该怎么回答。
